Today’s M&A briefing — 14 deals, the strategies behind them · 18 November 2026

🔹 ICEYE (synthetic aperture radar (SAR) observation satellites, imagery sold to defense, humanitarian, and insurance clients) acquires Avio (italian space launcher manufacturer) — €2bn.

🔹 Day One (supports companies in their solidarity engagement initiatives: skills-based volunteering, employee volunteering, CSR programs, based in Orléans) acquires Benevolt (nantes-based platform connecting volunteers and associations, founded in 2017, over 370,000 volunteers and 8,700 associations listed).

🔹 Sarre Moselle Logistique (transport and logistics) acquires Transmat Flauder (sarreinsming-based transporter founded in 1974).

🔹 Anticimex (swedish multinational specializing) acquires Trahicsa (pest control, legionella prevention).

🔹 Grupo Tello (spanish group active) acquires Moreno Plaza (andalusian operator specializing in fresh meat).

🔹 Zazume (barcelona-based proptech that digitizes the full lifecycle management of long-term residential leases) takes a stake in 40 % du capital de Garanty Home (real estate franchise network operating).

🔹 Grupo Alonso (spanish logistics and transport holding company present on five continents: international transport, port terminals, rail, storage) acquires Cargo Line Freight and Logistics (logistics for luxury fashion brands between Europe and the Middle East, and freight transport for solar infrastructure projects in the region).

🔹 Dacke Industri (swedish industrial group) takes a stake in 80 % d'ASO Safety Solutions (industrial safety sensors).

🔹 Teracom (swedish state-owned company specializing) acquires Västervik Drone Science Park (swedish national drone testing and development center designated by the Swedish Transport Agency, operating the country's first and largest UAS zone).

🔹 EQT (swedish asset manager) acquires Flatiron Energy (american developer and operator of large-scale battery energy storage projects in the northeastern United States, founded in 2021).

🔹 Biomapas (outsourced pharmaceutical services group: regulatory affairs, pharmacovigilance, clinical development, digital consulting) acquires l'activité CMC d'Alira Health (boston-based team of over 35 specialists supporting biopharma companies in preclinical and clinical phases on monoclonal antibodies, ADCs).

🔹 Indivi (swiss neurotech company based in Basel) acquires Cogitat (imperial College London spin-out).

🔹 Cooltra (barcelona-based light mobility operator founded) acquires Motto (electric bike subscription including maintenance).

🔹 ADU cède son activité intérim à Piening.

en.text:
Today’s fundraising briefing — 7 deals, the strategies behind them · 18 November 2026

🔹 Isomorphic Labs (AI-driven drug design, IsoDDE engine working on multiple therapeutic areas and modalities simultaneously) — €4.5bn · Series C.
Series B had reached 1.8 billion euros in the first half of 2026. Isomorphic treats molecular biology as a large-scale modeling problem, similar to a large language model applied to text.
𝗨𝘀𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗳𝘂𝗻𝗱𝘀: Transition from computational design to therapeutic candidates in clinical trials.
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: What the 4.5 billion funds is not a drug: it is the demonstration that the radical compression of the drug discovery phase is possible on an industrial scale.

🔹 Tiberius Aerospace (precision-guided artillery ammunition, long-range 155mm Sceptre shells, and AI-assisted defense manufacturing software) — $85m · Series A.
Valuation over 1 billion dollars. Contract signed with the British Ministry of Defense to develop Sceptre.
𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀: Lakestar (Zurich) and Rochefort Asset Management (USA) (lead investors); Dream Ventures, AeroX Ventures, Blacklake, Moonshots Capital, UA1.
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: Tiberius outsources production to local industrial partners in each client country, retaining only IP and licensing revenues, and can scale geographically without immobilizing fixed capital — this is the industrial franchise model applied to defense.

🔹 Remanence — $30m.
Founded by Pierre-Louis Cedoz, Hamza Benchekroun, and Axel Moyal, former heads of post-training for Holo open models at H Company, with backgrounds at Google DeepMind, InstaDeep, and Meta.
𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀: EQT Ventures, FirstMark.
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: Remanence proposes to recover AI agent execution data — currently lost in provider logs — to build a specialized model that the company truly owns, independent of the generalist model provider.

🔹 Qluster (quantum computer based on continuous variable photonics using light as a computational medium) — €4.7m · pre-seed.
Founded by David Fainsin, Ambroise Boyer, Clarisse Thibault, and Valentina Parigi. Roadmap: intermediate quantum computer by 2032, fault-tolerant universal quantum computer by 2036.

🔹 Previsia (AI risk prevention platform bringing together insured company, broker, and insurer around shared data, covering setup, visit) — €3.8m.
𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀: IRDI Capital Investissement, ARIS (two independent regional funds).

🔹 Speeral (automation of resale of unsold items and returns from merchants on second-hand platforms via AI agents that generate listings) — €2.5m · Seed.

🔹 Caslog (portable device recording combat medic's voice to automatically convert it into a medical record for war casualties) — €360,000 · pre-seed.

fr.text:
Levées de fonds : les 7 opérations chiffrées de l'édito du 18 novembre 2026.

🔹 Isomorphic Labs (𝑐𝑜𝑛𝑐𝑒𝑝𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑑𝑒 𝑚𝑒́𝑑𝑖𝑐𝑎𝑚𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑠 𝑝𝑎𝑟 𝑖𝑛𝑡𝑒𝑙𝑙𝑖𝑔𝑒𝑛𝑐𝑒 𝑎𝑟𝑡𝑖𝑓𝑖𝑐𝑖𝑒𝑙𝑙𝑒) — 4,5 Md€ · Série C.
La Série B avait atteint 1,8 milliard d'euros au premier semestre 2026. Isomorphic traite la biologie moléculaire comme un problème de modélisation à grande échelle, à l'image d'un grand modèle de langage appliqué au texte.
𝗢𝗯𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗳 : Passer de la conception computationnelle à des candidats thérapeutiques en essais cliniques.
𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲 𝘃𝘂𝗲 : Ce que les 4,5 milliards financent, ce n'est pas un médicament : c'est la démonstration que la compression radicale de la phase de découverte médicamenteuse est possible à l'échelle industrielle.

🔹 Tiberius Aerospace (𝑚𝑢𝑛𝑖𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛𝑠 𝑑'𝑎𝑟𝑡𝑖𝑙𝑙𝑒𝑟𝑖𝑒 𝑎̀ 𝑔𝑢𝑖𝑑𝑎𝑔𝑒 𝑑𝑒 𝑝𝑟𝑒́𝑐𝑖𝑠𝑖𝑜𝑛) — 85 M$ · Série A.
Valorisation supérieure à 1 milliard de dollars. Contrat signé avec le ministère de la Défense britannique pour développer Sceptre.
𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲 𝘃𝘂𝗲 : Tiberius externalise la production à des partenaires industriels locaux dans chaque pays client, ne garde que l'IP et les revenus de licence, et peut scaler géographiquement sans immobiliser de capital fixe — c'est le modèle de la franchise industrielle appliqué à la défense.

🔹 Remanence — 30 M$.
Fondée par Pierre-Louis Cedoz, Hamza Benchekroun et Axel Moyal, anciens responsables du post-entraînement des modèles ouverts Holo chez H Company, avec des parcours chez Google DeepMind, InstaDeep et Meta.
𝗔𝘃𝗲𝗰 : EQT Ventures, FirstMark.
𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲 𝘃𝘂𝗲 : Remanence propose de récupérer les données d'exécution des agents IA — aujourd'hui perdues dans les logs des fournisseurs — pour construire un modèle spécialisé que l'entreprise possède réellement, indépendant du fournisseur de modèle généraliste.

🔹 Qluster (𝑜𝑟𝑑𝑖𝑛𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑢𝑟 𝑞𝑢𝑎𝑛𝑡𝑖𝑞𝑢𝑒 𝑓𝑜𝑛𝑑𝑒́ 𝑠𝑢𝑟 𝑙𝑎 𝑝ℎ𝑜𝑡𝑜𝑛𝑖𝑞𝑢𝑒 𝑎̀ 𝑣𝑎𝑟𝑖𝑎𝑏𝑙𝑒𝑠 𝑐𝑜𝑛𝑡𝑖𝑛𝑢𝑒𝑠 𝑢𝑡𝑖𝑙𝑖𝑠𝑎𝑛𝑡 𝑙𝑎 𝑙𝑢𝑚𝑖𝑒̀𝑟𝑒 𝑐𝑜𝑚𝑚𝑒 𝑠𝑢𝑝𝑝𝑜𝑟𝑡 𝑑𝑒 𝑐𝑎𝑙𝑐𝑢𝑙, 𝑖𝑠𝑠𝑢𝑒 𝑑𝑢 𝐿𝑎𝑏𝑜𝑟𝑎𝑡𝑜𝑖𝑟𝑒 𝐾𝑎𝑠𝑡𝑙𝑒𝑟 𝐵𝑟𝑜𝑠𝑠𝑒𝑙, 𝑃𝑎𝑟𝑖𝑠) — 4,7 M€ · pré-amorçage.

🔹 Previsia (𝑝𝑙𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑓𝑜𝑟𝑚𝑒 𝐼𝐴 𝑑𝑒 𝑝𝑟𝑒́𝑣𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑑𝑒𝑠 𝑟𝑖𝑠𝑞𝑢𝑒𝑠 𝑟𝑒́𝑢𝑛𝑖𝑠𝑠𝑎𝑛𝑡 𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑟𝑒𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑠𝑒 𝑎𝑠𝑠𝑢𝑟𝑒́𝑒) — 3,8 M€.

🔹 Speeral (𝑎𝑢𝑡𝑜𝑚𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑠𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑑𝑒 𝑙𝑎 𝑟𝑒𝑣𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑒 𝑑'𝑖𝑛𝑣𝑒𝑛𝑑𝑢𝑠 𝑒𝑡 𝑟𝑒𝑡𝑜𝑢𝑟𝑠 𝑑𝑒 𝑐𝑜𝑚𝑚𝑒𝑟𝑐̧𝑎𝑛𝑡𝑠 𝑠𝑢𝑟 𝑝𝑙𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑓𝑜𝑟𝑚𝑒𝑠 𝑑'𝑜𝑐𝑐𝑎𝑠𝑖𝑜𝑛) — 2,5 M€ · Seed.

🔹 Caslog (𝑑𝑖𝑠𝑝𝑜𝑠𝑖𝑡𝑖𝑓 𝑝𝑜𝑟𝑡𝑎𝑏𝑙𝑒 𝑒𝑛𝑟𝑒𝑔𝑖𝑠𝑡𝑟𝑎𝑛𝑡 𝑙𝑎 𝑣𝑜𝑖𝑥 𝑑𝑢 𝑚𝑒́𝑑𝑒𝑐𝑖𝑛 𝑑𝑒 𝑐𝑜𝑚𝑏𝑎𝑡) — 360 000 € · pré-amorçage.
